algolia.name: Belkin - USB Smart Card/CAC Reader
algolia.description: This Belkin F1DN005U USB smart card/CAC reader supports Class A, B and C cards and features a FIPS 201- and TAA-compliant design for ideal use in a variety of security capacities. The ROM (Read Only Memory) firmware offers additional hardware protection.
